selection: the system phrases that define the parts of a calculator page
description: The keywords of the calculator view (docs/llm/new_view_sample_pv_balance.md), so that the inputs, the assumptions, the result columns, the row groups, the detail tables and the labels and hints of a calculator page are defined by the triples of a use case file and not by code. A list is a group triple from the phrase to a list keyword, whose items are the triples from the group; a label, a hint or a flag is a triple from an item or from a phrase to the property keyword. This file is imported as the last step of the db setup, so that no database id of a tested phrase moves.

words.name: calculator
words.description: a page that calculates results from the inputs of the user for one initial phrase e.g. a PV installation

words.name: hint
words.description: a short help text shown next to or below a label

words.name: highlight
words.description: a mark that makes an item stand out e.g. a key row of a result table

words.name: sign
words.description: whether a number is positive or negative

words.name: repeat
words.description: an input that the user can add and remove several times e.g. one target weight per child

words.name: section
words.description: a part of a page that can be opened and closed

triples.name: zukunft.com system
triples.description: keyword for system internal triples such as the column definitions

triples.name: calculator (system)
triples.description: keyword of the calculator view; a phrase gets its calculator page by the triples to the keywords below

triples.name: calculator label
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from an item or from a phrase to this keyword is the label of the item e.g. the page title, a heading, a field label, a column header or a row label; the label of the item wins over the label of its phrase

triples.name: calculator hint
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from an item or from a phrase to this keyword is the hint of the item e.g. the lead text or the sub text of a row; the hint of the item wins over the hint of its phrase

triples.name: calculator input
triples.description: list: the items of the group triple to this keyword are the input fields

triples.name: calculator assumption
triples.description: list: the assumptions shown first and with a label; the other operands follow sorted by label

triples.name: calculator result column
triples.description: list: the column phrases of the main result table

triples.name: calculator row group
triples.description: list of lists: the row groups of the main result table, each with its rows; a row has with filters, and its side results are the has a triples of the row phrase or the filter phrase

triples.name: calculator detail table
triples.description: list: the detail tables, each with its columns (has a) and its extra rows (with)

triples.name: calculator highlight
triples.description: flag: an item, or a phrase on every page, with a triple to this keyword is shown as a key row

triples.name: calculator signed
triples.description: flag: the cells of a row group with a triple to this keyword show the sign of the number

triples.name: calculator number note
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from a row to this keyword is a short note that the page shows behind the unit of the number in the label of the row e.g. PV-weighted

triples.name: calculator repeat
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: field type: an input item with a triple to this keyword is shown once per instance with an add and a remove button e.g. the target weight of every child; the minimum and the maximum count are the values field limit down and field limit up of the triple to this keyword, the instances are the phrases that is a the item phrase e.g. first child portfolio, a new instance is named by the next ordinal word, and the result columns and the detail table columns of the repeated phrase follow the count; needs a repeat field and a dynamic column list in the frontend code

triples.name: calculator checkbox
triples.description: field type: an input phrase with a triple to this keyword is shown as a checkbox with its label and hint e.g. mirror the children or split cash; checked is the value 1, unchecked the value 0, so a formula can use it as a factor

triples.name: calculator read only
triples.description: flag: an input item with a triple to this keyword shows the number of its phrase instead of a field e.g. the target weight of the parent

triples.name: calculator warning
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: text property: the description of a triple from a result phrase to this keyword is shown below the input fields as a warning while the result of the page phrase is above zero e.g. the excess of the weights of the children above 100 %; needs a warning in calculator_fields and the sign of a result or a comparison in the formula engine

triples.name: calculator section
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: flag: a detail table, a check table, a diagram or the notes with a triple to this keyword get a collapsed section of their own with their label as the summary, in the order of the is follower of chain e.g. check, deviation diagram, splitting walk, holdings, notes and sources; needs a section per item in calculation_result instead of one block for all details

triples.name: calculator editable
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: flag: the cells of a detail table column with a triple to this keyword are number fields that join the save form e.g. the quantity, the price and the lot size of the holdings; needs input cells in calculation_detail_tables

triples.name: calculator phrase column
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: list item property: a detail table column with a triple to this keyword shows instead of a number the phrase that the numbers of the row have and that is a column phrase e.g. CHF, which is a currency, for a holding; needs a phrase cell in calculation_detail_tables

triples.name: calculator row number
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: flag: a detail table with a triple to this keyword shows the position of the row as the first column e.g. the step of the splitting walk

triples.name: calculator decimals
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: number property: a value with a phrase and this keyword sets the decimals of every cell of the phrase e.g. 0 for shares and 2 for cash, so that one column shows the rows with different decimals

triples.name: calculator colour
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: flag: the columns of a list with a triple to this keyword get the colours of the page palette in their order e.g. the dark blue for the parent and four cycling blues for the children, in the header, the cells and the diagram lines

triples.name: calculator note
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: list: the items of the group triple to this keyword are the notes of the page: the description of an item is the text with the label of the item in bold in front, in the order of the is follower of chain and before the formula notes e.g. why the order of the walk matters

triples.name: calculator check
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: a triple from the base phrase to this keyword shows a check table with one row per value of the page with the word expected: the expected number, the calculated number, which is the number with the same phrases without expected, and match or differs as the status; the source of the expected value is the hint of the row e.g. the split agreement; needs a new component type calculator_check

triples.name: calculator diagram
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: flag: a detail table column with a triple to this keyword is also drawn as a line along the rows of its table in a diagram below the table, with a legend of the last numbers e.g. the cumulative deviation of every child along the walk; needs a diagram in calculation_detail_tables

triples.name: calculator file import
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: button: a triple from a list, an item or a detail table to this keyword shows an import button, whose label is the label of the triple and whose file fills the values of its phrase e.g. import the portfolio or the exchange rates; needs the file import of the calculator page

triples.name: calculator download
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: button: a triple from the inputs list to this keyword shows a download button that exports the tables of the page as a spreadsheet

triples.name: calculator printable report
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: button: a triple from the inputs list to this keyword shows a report button that shows the page as a printable pdf

triples.name: calculator copy
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: button: a triple from a detail table to this keyword shows the two buttons copy as zukunft.com json and copy as csv, which copy the rows of the table to the clipboard and shows the text selected if copying is blocked

triples.name: calculator page independent
triples.description: PROPOSED NEW ELEMENT: flag: an item, a detail table or the check table with a triple to this keyword selects its numbers without the page phrase e.g. the holdings of a bank statement, which are the same for every split of the depot; needs the numbers of the walked phrases without the page phrase in calculator_numbers
